स्टॉपवे की लंबाई

The length of a stopway usable in the event of a rejected take-off, beyond the take-off run available.

Definition

The length of a stopway usable in the event of a rejected take-off, beyond the take-off run available.

Operational example

Tower: Runway 16 has a stopway length of three hundred meters beyond the take-off run.

Localized term

स्टॉपवे की लंबाई

Localized example
